title: Rabobank
body:
O.P.
this post was edited
Anyone with Rabobank. I completed the online application yesterday and received a text shortly after advising of my new high interest savings account number and digipass will be sent to my home address. At the conclusion of the online application there were further instructions to send some money from my external linked bank account so that they could verify it. I have done this and today I was waiting to receive verification. Both email address and mobile Number were provided to Rabo and nothing has come through. Is this normal as I would think they would keep you in the loop. I have had other bank accounts with different institutions and they always notified you on what was going on. I cannot even log into my rabo account to check as you need the digipass which is still on its way. Thanks.

---- replies ----
[User #5633152695 postsPotentialDonkeysuggested username.Whirlpool Forums Addict] I don't recall receiving any confirmation myself either now that you mention it...
[User #79193913013 postsgregbluesWhirlpool Forums Addict] I wouldn't worry about it they will contact you soon. It usually takes a day or two for the funds to be cleared to your new account so they are probably waiting for that to happen.
I've been with Rabo for a few years now and will be opening another term deposit next week because I can't find anybody who pays more than 1.75% for 12 months. I know it isn't much but interest rates are still on the way down.
The digi pass takes a few days.
[User #292923788 postssoftel1Whirlpool Enthusiast] O.P.
Thanks for the info. correct! Can't beat the higher interest rates on offer.
[User #292923788 postssoftel1Whirlpool Enthusiast] O.P.
Had to call them up myself for confirmation regarding the successful transfer of my money. Received the digipass today and now have access to the online and mobile app. The security with the digipass is way over the top and probably not needed in today's IT world. Looking at the reviews online and over half of the comments speak negatively about the Rabo digipass. Rabobank I feel would get more customers if they ditched this contraption and adopt the more simpler security measures used by the other banks and financial institutions.

The security with the digipass is way over the top and probably not needed in today's IT world.
Indeed, and particularly as most HISA account-holder vanish when the sweetheart period ends, and the dongle goes in the bin. They're not heavy enough to repurpose as a paperweight.

(At least or until they update the app.)

Rabo is the one bank where I prefer using the app, not surprisingly. :/
[User #292923788 postssoftel1Whirlpool Enthusiast] O.P.
As I don't rely on Rabo for my day to day banking the digipass is not that inconvenient for me. I mainly just use their mobile app to check in on the account every now and then. The only inconvenience as with most other financial institutions is moving all your money out of the account when the "honey moon" rate expires. In the old days they would beg you to stay by offering a good deal that you could not resist. Unfortunately customer loyalty is not a priority for them anymore.
[User #90242042 postsrvelthuisParticipant] Rabobank offering 5.75% with no hoops for 4 months
This seems too good. Any thoughts ?
https://www.rabobank.com.au/ high-interest-savings-accoun t/?utm_source=Google&utm_med ium=Search_CPC&utm_campaign= Brand_AR_Online_Savings_EM%2 BPM&utm_term=HISA&gad_source =1&gclid=EAIaIQobChMIoYP1qLv ohAMVuso8Ah1yogDREAAYASAAEgI VvPD_BwE&gclsrc=aw.ds
[User #8879722591 posts27.56Whirlpool Forums Addict] Take advantage of it while you can. You only get it once. To get it a second time you have to close your accounts and wait 3 years. I've still got some time left to wait for my second time round , otherwise I'd be straight on it.
[User #733814492 postsMitty Oz97% of experts agreeWhirlpool Forums Addict] ^The intro rate is a great deal, I'd jump on it while you can. Beware that if rates go down in that time, the intro rate also goes down (conversely if they happen to go up, the intro rate also goes up!).
I quite like Rabo, given the way the account works and the digipass, I feel like it's a very safe place to put your money as there's a very low risk of being scammed etc. If their standard rate was better, I would totally use them all the time but my guess is in the world of WP savers, it's only ever used for the intro rate and then shelved.
My partner recently used the intro deal and it was a very pleasant experience all round (plus, when it did come time to transfer the balance out, it was a no fuss process unlike lots of others who scream "scam" the moment you try and transfer out 5 cents).
EDIT the thought does occur that I wonder if you were to open a joint account with someone, would that count as a "new" customer, or not.
[User #7331391096 postsMalleysWhirlpool Enthusiast] News!
I just telephoned to check that I would be eligible for the introductory rate on the high interest savings account, since I closed my last account three years ago.
There has been a recent change. The eligibility is now not having had an account open for two years .
By the way, any questions you may have, their call centre is behind a 1800 number so nothing lost asking them directly. My call was transferred to overseas but I have absolutely no problem talking to a kiwi in New Zealand, they will always go the extra mile to help you out.
[User #3816403003 postsM'bozoI'm somebody I used to know...Whirlpool Forums Addict] Mitty Oz writes...
it's only ever used for the intro rate and then shelved.
I'm using the intro deal, waiting to see what happens with interest rates next week before deciding where move to after my 4 months expires at the end of this month.
